reason: The claimed necessity is false/overstated. By validated 1.7.4, Pi_delta:A:=calU x B_delta^{calH}(J)->S_delta is already a bijection, hence injective, with inverse (u_pol,h_pol). To identify u_grp(X)=u_pol(X) it suffices, for each relevant X, to exhibit h_X in B_delta^{calH}(J) with Pi_delta(u_grp(X),h_X)=X: injectivity/uniqueness of the preimage gives (u_grp(X),h_X)=(u_pol(X),h_pol(X)). This requires only a right-inverse/preimage identity, not proving X↦(u_grp(X),h(X)) is a two-sided inverse on the whole source and target. For the parent transport it would be enough even pointwise on X=U bold-dot V and X=U^dagger. Thus node 1.7.5.2 incorrectly elevates a sufficient full synchronization condition to a necessary one.
